newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein buys German medical co.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein buys German medical co.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc said Thursday it acquired privately held Medi-Quick Arzt GambH & Co, a medical and dental products marketer based in Bad Laer, Germany.
The company declined to disclose the purchase price.
The company said Medi-Quick had net sales of about $14.3 million in 1996, with the majority of the sales in the medical marketplace.
The company said the acquisition is expected to be accretive in its first year of operations, and subject to certain closing conditions, is expected to close in 90 days.
The company also said it is opening a telemarketing office in Vienna, Austria and launching its first Austrian dental catalog.
